subject: SIG / CAIQ intake: log retention, encryption at rest & evidence handoff
messages:
From: Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@hexagramlabs.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG / CAIQ kickoff and a couple encryption questions

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this on. We just started the SIG/CAIQ for Hexagram's security review and I wanted to get a kickoff scheduled and clarify a couple of items up front so we can scope evidence properly.

Two quick asks before we book time:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood provides customer-key encryption at rest (we need KMS/HSM details)?
- For log exports, what time range granularity do you support for pulling tenant-level audit logs? We need 90-day slices but may request 1-year archives.

I'll attach our current questionnaire (spreadsheet) in a follow-up. Our security lead Priyanka (cc'd) will join the call.

Availability: Wed/Thu morning PT works best for us.

Thanks,
Sam Tucker
Head of Security Operations
Hexagram Labs

Attachment: Hexagram_SIG_RawQuestions_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
To: Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@hexagramlabs.com>
Cc: Priyanka Desai <priyanka.desai@hexagramlabs.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ kickoff and a couple encryption questions

Sam — thanks for the context and the spreadsheet. Happy to run the kickoff and triage the questionnaire.

Quick answers up front:
- Encryption at rest: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via KMS integrations. For hosted deployments we integrate with cloud KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault). For Private deployments we offer HSM-backed key wrapping and can support a customer-provided key policy. I will bring Ben from our infrastructure security team to go through KMS/HSM specifics on the call.
- Log exports: we provide tenant-scoped audit logs with export windows down to 1-hour granularity; for retention we support on-demand archive pulls (we typically ship 90-day rolling extracts and can produce longer historical exports upon request).

Propose: Wed 14 Apr 2027 @ 10:00 AM PT for a 45-minute kickoff (agenda: clarify CAIQ/SIG scope, confirm evidence owners, schedule log export dry run). Does that work?

I'll attach a short runbook (redwood_log_export_instructions.md) we use for customers when requesting exports.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_log_export_instructions.md (text stub)

From: Priyanka Desai <priyanka.desai@hexagramlabs.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, Sam Tucker <sam.tucker@hexagramlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ kickoff and a couple encryption questions

Olga, thanks for the quick reply — Wed 10:00 AM PT works.

One extra item: can Redwood confirm whether logs contain the full request URI (including query params) or if query strings are redacted by default? We need to know for PII scoping.

See you tomorrow.

—Priyanka
Security Lead, Hexagram Labs

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: Priyanka Desai <priyanka.desai@hexagramlabs.com>, olga.petrov@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 10:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ kickoff and a couple encryption questions

Priyanka — quick note following today's call (thanks everyone):

Notes and action items (45-min kickoff, 14 Apr 2027):
- Confirmed scope: SIG v2 + CAIQ focused on hosted API + Dedicated tenant (NO on-prem for this project).
- Encryption at rest: hosted customers can use cloud-managed CMKs; we can provide KMS usage logs and Key ARN metadata. For Dedicated, we support HSM-backed wrapping and customer-supplied key material. (Owner: Ben C.)
- Log contents: request URI query strings are redacted by default in application-level logs. Audit logs carry request path, method, timestamp, and truncated user identifier tokens sufficient for investigation. We can provide a sampling of sanitized request traces for review. (Owner: Ben C.)
- Log export cadence & format: standard export is NDJSON with hourly partitions; we can deliver 90-day rolling exports via secure SFTP or share a pre-signed object. For one-year archives, we'll provision a longer export and schedule a dry run. (Owner: Marissa C.)
- Evidence handoff: Hexagram to upload completed SIG spreadsheet; Redwood will return mapping of control evidence and attach redacted log samples.
- Scheduling: dry-run export slot requested for Fri 16 Apr 2027 @ 08:00 AM PT (proposed) — need Hexagram confirmation.

Attachments committed: redwood_log_export_instructions.md, sample_redacted_logs.ndjson (will be uploaded to the drive link below).

Olga — please confirm owners and timelines; Priyanka/Sam if the Fri 08:00 slot works, say ok and we'll reserve the export pipeline.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Staff Cloud Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Ben / Olga — thanks for the clear notes. Confirming:
- Hexagram will upload the completed SIG sheet by EOD Thu 15 Apr.
- The Fri 16 Apr 2027 08:00 AM PT dry-run export slot works for our ops team — please send the access details (SFTP or presigned URL) and the exact sample fields you will include so we can validate PII redaction.

One small ask: for the KMS keys we plan to request the ARN and a short description of key rotation cadence for the hosted environment — can you include that in the evidence bundle?

Appreciate it — see you on Fri.

Sam Tucker

Hexagram Labs
